executable.title: Ridgelet Directions Compute
executable.description: Compute spherical ridgelets direct fiber directions from dMRI data.

parameters.label: Input dMRI Data
parameters.description: Input diffusion MRI volume and parameters for spherical ridgelets computation.

string-vector.name: input_mask
string-vector.label: Input Mask Volume
string-vector.description: Optional brain mask volume. Voxels with value less than or equal to 0 are skipped.

parameters.label: Spherical Ridgelets Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters controlling the spherical ridgelets basis and computation.

integer.name: sph_J
integer.label: Spherical Ridgelets J
integer.description: J value for spherical ridgelets basis (positive integer). Default: 2.

double.name: sph_rho
double.label: Spherical Ridgelets Rho
double.description: Rho value for spherical ridgelets (float greater than 0). Default: 3.125.

integer.name: lvl
integer.label: Icosahedron Tesselation Order
integer.description: Order of icosahedron tesselation for ODF computation. Default: 4.

integer.name: n_splits
integer.label: Number of Splits
integer.description: Split coefficient for ridgelets computation. Default: -1 (auto).

double.name: fista_lambda
double.label: FISTA Lambda
double.description: Lambda parameter for FISTA solver (between 0 and 1). Default: 0.01.

double.name: fista_tolerance
double.label: FISTA Tolerance
double.description: Tolerance parameter for FISTA convergence (between 0 and 1). Default: 0.0001.

integer.name: nth
integer.label: Number of Threads
integer.description: Number of threads to use. Default: -1 (auto).

boolean.name: is_compress
boolean.label: Enable Compression
boolean.description: Enable NRRD file compression for output volumes.

parameters.label: Output Options
parameters.description: Select which outputs to generate. At least one output is required.

string-vector.name: output_fiber_max_ridgelets
string-vector.label: Direct Ridgelet Maxima (-omd_r)
string-vector.description: Output direct ridgelet maxima directions and values volume (24 components). This is the main output for visualization.

double.name: ridgelet_nms_angle
double.label: Direct Ridgelet NMS Angle
double.description: Non-maximum suppression angle for direct ridgelet maxima (degrees). Default: 20.

double.name: max_odf_thresh
double.label: ODF Maxima Threshold
double.description: Threshold for ODF maxima search (between 0 and 1). Default: 0.7.
